entities.summary: Lafoga Jordan Mailata is an Australian professional American football offensive tackle for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL) and former rugby league player. He previously played rugby league for the Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs under-18s team and the South Sydney Rabbitohs on their under-20s team. He joined the NFL via the league's International Player Pathway Program and was selected in the seventh round, 233rd overall by the Eagles in the 2018 NFL draft. In 2025, Mailata was an integral part of the Eagles team that won Super Bowl LIX, the second title in the team's history.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Jordan Mailata's selection in the 2018 NFL draft marked a significant milestone for Pacific Islander representation in the league. His win with the Philadelphia Eagles in Super Bowl LIX in 2025 further solidified his place as a trailblazer for Indigenous Australian athletes in professional sports.
